intelligence.enrichment: In science, curiosity becomes investigation when a question is focused enough to guide careful observation, thoughtful experimentation, and clear explanation of what is seen. Focused questions determine what can be observed, tested, and explained; unfocused curiosity does not by itself define an investigation. The learner classifies a question as scientific when it is focused enough to guide careful observation, thoughtful experimentation, and clear explanation. Any interesting why question, such as why one side of a puri is thinner, is already a scientific investigation.
